name: Fatutu
bio: Archetype: Extra Action, Cleanser, Healing, HP Share. ⌽ Gains [Spirit Shell]s at battle start. When the holder gets hit, transfers a shell to the other side (Fatutu↔enemies). Enemies with [Spirit Shell]s take more damage from Extra Actions. ⌽ Heals all team members when retrieving [Spirit Shell]s. Small chance to gain Moxie when applying [Spirit Shell]s to an enemy. ⌽ After a certain number of shell transfers, casts S1, applying [Spirit Shell]s and cleansing debuffs from allies. ⌽ S2 evenly redistributes team HP and retrieves all [Spirit Shell]s. ⌽ Ult applies all [Spirit Shell]s onto one target and inflicts [Shell Beacon]: When retrieving [Spirit Shell]s, immediately reapply them.
